summary: Adds two admin routes. One deletes a single user by id, and the other purges a list of user ids.

findings.title: Delete user route lacks admin check
findings.problem: The DELETE /admin/users/:id route does not use the requireAdmin middleware, but its sibling routes do. The server mounts the admin router without any router-wide auth in src/server.js:6.
findings.consequence: Any caller who can reach the server can delete any user by id. They can also enumerate ids to wipe the user table.
findings.fix: Add requireAdmin to the route, as the GET and purge routes do.

findings.title: Floating removeUser promises in purge loop
findings.problem: The purge handler passes an async callback to forEach, so nothing awaits or catches the removeUser promises. db.removeUser throws for an unknown id at src/db.js:10.
findings.consequence: One unknown id in the purge list causes an unhandled rejection, which crashes the Node process by default. The response also reports removals before any removal finishes.
findings.fix: Await all removals with Promise.allSettled and count the fulfilled ones. Then respond with that count.
findings.suggested_change:
const results = await Promise.allSettled(ids.map((id) => db.removeUser(id)));
  res.json({ removed: results.filter((r) => r.status === "fulfilled").length });

findings.title: Purge reports requested count as removed count
findings.problem: The purge handler returns ids.length as the removed count. It does this even when some removals fail or are still pending.
findings.consequence: Admins see a removed count that can be higher than the number of users actually deleted.
findings.fix: Count only the successful removals after they settle.

findings.title: New admin routes have no covering test
findings.problem: The change adds the delete and purge routes but no test file. The repository holds no test that exercises either route.
findings.consequence: Regressions in authorization or purge error handling will go unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add tests for both routes. Cover the admin check, unknown ids and the reported removed count.
